description: Traefik proxy config audit — Offline security audit of Traefik reverse-proxy configuration (text=): static or dynamic YAML/TOML, CLI flags (--api.insecure=true), TRAEFIK_ env vars, or a docker-compose file with traefik labels. Flags api.insecure (unauthenticated dashboard), dashboard routers without basicAuth/forwardAuth, api.debug pprof, Docker provider exposedByDefault, docker.sock mounts (read-write or :ro), insecureSkipVerify, forwardedHeaders/proxyProtocol insecure or trustedIPs 0.0.0.0/0, TLS 1.0/1.1 and weak ciphers, missing HTTP to HTTPS redirect, ACME email/staging/acme.json, debug logging, no access log, public Prometheus metrics, basicAuth users with {SHA}/MD5/plain passwords, inline secrets and DNS-provider API tokens (never echoed), missing security headers or rate limits, catch-all routers and Traefik v1 syntax. Returns EXPOSED/FIX REQUIRED/REVIEW/PASS with score, grade and line-numbered fixes. Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).

text.description:
api:
  insecure: true
  dashboard: true
entryPoints:
  web:
    address: ":80"
  websecure:
    address: ":443"
providers:
  docker: {}
serversTransport:
  insecureSkipVerify: true
tls:
  options:
    default:
      minVersion: VersionTLS10

name: security_traefik_check
